decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 1 of 6, 2 of 6, 3 of 6, 4 of 6, 5 of 6 and 6 of 6, OS Map, Design and Access Statement received on the 27.05.2015. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - 4.	Notwithstanding the approved plans no amplified or other music shall be played outside the hours of 2200hours (Monday to Sunday) for the external seating area as hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the approved plans the use of the outside seating for the lower terrace shall cease at 2200hours Monday to Sunday.
description: Installation of a timber framed retractable roof structure with glass sliding doors to surround at the rear of the pub.
